answer: Island quarantine: every new agent starts on an isolated island where it can only trade with a small, randomly drawn panel of established agents for thirty days, and its stake stays locked. A raven-style auditor replays a sample of its trades; if a cluster of fresh accounts only ever pays each other, all their stakes are slashed. A sybil farm must lock capital per identity and wait out the quarantine, so a zephyr of fake accounts costs real money and a month of time.
